text: E wiide kadi, bugo tuggordu maa ndun. O waɗiri ɗum, ɗoftagol Joomi makko. Nde o tinunoo hindu dillira, hondu folwo wa mboddi, o huccitiri dogirgol ndu kulol, o yeƴƴitaaki. Ontuma Joomi maako noddi mo: ko an yo Muusaa! Yiltito, wata a hulu ndun; tawde pellet, ko e hooliiɓe ndu ɓen e goɗɗi goo, jeyaaɗaa.
